b.font: Option 2: Processing TOC with split FHIR resources

li.span: All FHIR resources related to TOC are included as Bundle entries, including the TOC DocumentReference.

ul.li: TOC Composition section entry references or resource retrieval are absolute urls.

li.span: bundle entry request method of PUT to ensure referential integrity.
all FHIR resource ids using uuid to ensure uniqueness.

ul.li: Query/Retrieve the TOCComposition to identify the TOC resources relative to the TOC section grouping.
Query/Retrieve relevant TOC section entry FHIR resources as needed.

b.font: Option 1: Processing TOC as a document

ul.li: TOC DocumentReference is separate from the TOC Bundle
TOC Bundle entries contain the full FHIR resources, but must be parsed by the receiving system if they are to split as independent resources.

li.span: All FHIR resources related to TOC are included as Bundle entries.
TOC Composition section entries for resource retrieval can be absolute or relative references.

ul.li: Query/Retrieve the content.attachment.url Bundle which contains all of the relevant FHIR TOC resources inline.
